blocks.en: Abstract — A foundational humanoid motion tracker is expected to be able to track diverse, highly dynamic, and contact-rich motions. More importantly, it needs to operate stably in real-world scenarios against various dynamics disturbances, including terrains, external forces, and physical property changes for general practical use. To achieve this goal, we propose Any2Track (Track Any motions under Any disturbances), a two-stage RL framework to track various motions under multiple disturbances in the real world. Any2Track reformulates dynamics adaptability as an additional capability
blocks.zh: 摘要——一个基础人形机器人动作跟踪器应当能够跟踪多样、高度动态且富接触的动作。更重要的是，为了通用的实际应用，它需要在真实世界场景中稳定运行，抵御包括地形、外力和物理属性变化在内的各种动力学扰动。为了实现这一目标，我们提出了 Any2Track（Track Any motions under Any disturbances，在任意扰动下跟踪任意动作），这是一个用于在真实世界多重扰动下跟踪各种动作的两阶段强化学习（RL）框架。Any2Track 将动力学适应性重构为一种额外能力

blocks.en: I. INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: I. 引言

blocks.en: Humanoid motion tracking [1]–[6] aims to reproduce human motion sequences on a humanoid platform, enabling more expressive and anthropomorphic motion behavior compared with pure RL-based controllers [7]–[14]. A foundational humanoid motion tracker should be able to track diverse, highly dynamic, and contact-rich motions to capture general human motion knowledge. In addition, it needs to operate stably in real-world scenarios against various disturbances, including terrains, external forces, and physical property changes (e.g., payload, friction) for general practical use. However, existing humanoid motion trackers fail to have general motion tracking capability and dynamics adaptability simultaneously. They exhibit varying levels of limitations in motion tracking capabilities and resilience to different realworld disturbances. The comparison of existing works and our method is shown in Table I.
blocks.zh: 人形机器人动作跟踪 [1]–[6] 旨在将人类动作序列复现到人形机器人平台上，与纯基于强化学习的控制器 [7]–[14] 相比，能够实现更具表现力且更加拟人化的动作行为。一个基础的人形机器人动作跟踪器应当能够跟踪多样、高度动态且富接触的动作，以捕获通用的人类运动知识。此外，为了通用的实际应用，它需要在现实世界场景中稳定运行，抵御包括地形、外力和物理属性变化（例如负载、摩擦力）在内的各种扰动。然而，现有的人形机器人动作跟踪器无法同时具备通用动作跟踪能力与动力学适应性。它们在动作跟踪能力以及对不同现实世界扰动的抗扰恢复能力上表现出不同程度的局限性。现有工作与我们方法的对比见表 I。

blocks.en: The key challenges to construct a fundamental humanoid motion tracker can be summarized in two points: 1) how to construct a unified general motion tracker to efficiently and with high quality learn diverse motion control strategies; 2) how to endow the controller with online dynamics adaptability to overcome the sim2real dynamics gap and various real-world disturbances.
blocks.zh: 构建基础人形机器人动作跟踪器的关键挑战可归纳为两点：1) 如何构建统一的通用动作跟踪器，以高效且高质量地学习多样化的动作控制策略；2) 如何赋予控制器在线动力学适应能力，以克服仿真到现实的动力学差距以及各种现实世界的扰动。

blocks.en: Towards the goal of constructing a foundational humanoid motion tracker, we propose a two-stage RL framework called Any2Track ( Track Any motions under Any disturbances) in this work. Any2Track reformulates dynamics adaptability as an additional capability on top of basic action execution and consists of two key components: AnyTracker and AnyAdapter.
blocks.zh: 为了实现构建基础人形机器人动作跟踪器的目标，我们在本工作中提出了一个名为 Any2Track（Track Any motions under Any disturbances，在任意扰动下跟踪任意动作）的两阶段强化学习框架。Any2Track 将动力学适应性重构为基础动作执行之上的额外能力，包含两个关键组件：AnyTracker 和 AnyAdapter。

blocks.en: In the first stage, we construct AnyTracker , a general motion tracker to track diverse, highly dynamic, and contactrich motions. We found that the bottleneck in training a general motion tracker lies in the complex action spaces brought by high degrees of freedom and motion diversity. Thus, we propose a series of careful designs, including canonicalized action spaces and a specialist-to-generalist strategy, to alleviate the optimization difficulties brought by the complex action spaces. AnyTracker is trained as a base policy without any dynamics randomization to avoid tracking performance degradation.
blocks.zh: 在第一阶段，我们构建了 AnyTracker，这是一个用于跟踪多样、高度动态且富接触动作的通用动作跟踪器。我们发现，训练通用动作跟踪器的瓶颈在于高自由度和动作多样性所带来的复杂动作空间。因此，我们提出了一系列精心设计，包括规范化动作空间以及从专精到通用的策略（specialist-to-generalist strategy），以缓解复杂动作空间带来的优化困难。AnyTracker 作为基础策略进行训练，不引入任何动力学随机化，以避免跟踪性能退化。

blocks.en: In the second stage, we introduce dynamics variance and further propose a history-informed adaptation module on top of AnyTracker, which is called AnyAdapter . AnyAdapter endows the base tracker with online dynamics adaptability for different kinds of disturbances, including terrains, external forces, and physical property changes, without compromising its foundational expressive motion tracking capability. AnyAdapter utilizes dynamics-aware world model prediction as a proxy task to extract dynamics features as neural embeddings from the history buffer, which can serve as an informative representation to identify environment dynamics. Rather than directly finetuning the original parameters of the base tracker for dynamics adaptability, which may harm the tracking skills already acquired, we freeze the base tracker
blocks.zh: 在第二阶段，我们引入动力学变化，并在 AnyTracker 之上进一步提出了一个基于历史信息的自适应模块，称为 AnyAdapter。AnyAdapter 为基础跟踪器赋予了针对地形、外力和物理属性变化等不同类型扰动的在线动力学适应能力，同时不损害其基础的表现力丰富的动作跟踪能力。AnyAdapter 利用动力学感知世界模型预测作为代理任务，从历史缓冲区中提取作为神经嵌入的动力学特征，该特征可作为辨识环境动力学的信息丰富表征。为了实现动力学适应性，我们并没有直接微调基础跟踪器的原始参数（这可能会破坏已经学得的跟踪技能），而是冻结了基础跟踪器

blocks.en: and introduce an adapter [15] architecture. The adapter is trained to adaptively adjust the base policy’s actions to accommodate different environments, taking dynamics embeddings as input.
blocks.zh: 并引入了适配器 [15] 架构。该适配器以动力学嵌入作为输入，经过训练后能够自适应调整基础策略的动作，以适应不同的环境。

blocks.en: We deploy Any2Track on Unitree G1 hardware and achieve a successful sim2real transfer in a zero-shot manner. Our method shows impressive results in tracking diverse, highly dynamic, and contact-rich motions when faced with real-world disturbances from different sources, including terrains, external forces, and physical property changes. Extensive experiments are conducted both in the simulation and in the real world to validate the effectiveness of our major designs.
blocks.zh: 我们将 Any2Track 部署在 Unitree G1 硬件上，并以零样本方式成功实现了仿真到现实迁移。面对来自地形、外力和物理属性变化等不同源头的现实世界扰动，我们的方法在跟踪多样、高度动态且富接触的动作时展现出令人瞩目的成果。我们在仿真和真实世界中均进行了广泛的实验，以验证我们主要设计的有效性。

blocks.en: Our contributions are fourfold:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献主要有四个方面：

blocks.en: - ‚ Any2Track : A novel two-stage RL framework for robust humanoid motion tracking that excels under significant real-world disturbances.
blocks.zh: - Any2Track：一种新颖的两阶段强化学习框架，用于鲁棒的人形机器人动作跟踪，在显著的现实世界扰动下表现优异。

blocks.en: - ‚ AnyTracker : A general motion tracker with a series of careful designs to alleviate the optimization difficulties brought by complex action spaces and track diverse, highly dynamic, and contact-rich motions.
blocks.zh: - AnyTracker：一个通用动作跟踪器，通过一系列精心设计来缓解复杂动作空间带来的优化困难，并跟踪多样、高度动态且富接触的动作。

blocks.en: - ‚ AnyAdapter : A history-informed module that provides online adaptation to dynamic shifts and external perturbations, including terrains, external forces, and physical property changes.
blocks.zh: - AnyAdapter：一个基于历史信息的模块，为动力学变化和外部扰动（包括地形、外力以及物理属性变化）提供在线自适应。

blocks.en: - ‚ State-of-the-art Performance : We demonstrate superior real-world tracking under disturbances on the Unitree G1 hardware, validated by extensive experiments in both simulation and reality.
blocks.zh: - 最先进的性能（State-of-the-art Performance）：我们在 Unitree G1 硬件平台上展示了受扰动情况下卓越的真实世界动作跟踪表现，并通过仿真与真实环境中的大量实验进行了验证。

blocks.en: II. RELATED WORKS
blocks.zh: II. 相关工作

blocks.en: A. Motion Tracking
blocks.zh: A. 动作跟踪

blocks.en: Motion tracking aims to reproduce human motions to learn anthropomorphic whole-body controllers, which has been extensively studied in character animation [19]–[26]. [19] shows progressive results in constructing a general motion tracking strategy with dynamic, versatile, and perpetual tracking capability.
blocks.zh: 动作跟踪旨在复现人类动作以学习拟人化全身控制器，该方向在角色动画领域已得到广泛研究 [19]–[26]。[19] 展示了在构建具备高动态、多样化且持久跟踪能力的通用动作跟踪策略方面的显著进展。

blocks.en: Recently, robotics researchers have started to explore the reproduction of human motions on real-world humanoid hardware platforms [1]–[6], to enable more expressive motion behavior compared with pure RL-based controllers [7]– [10]. However, compared with character animation, motion tracking on humanoid robots still lags behind significantly due to the cross-embodiment gap, actuator limits, and simto-real challenges. HumanPlus [1] and OmniH2O [2] mainly focus on quasi-static loco-manipulation tasks. ASAP [6] achieves highly dynamic motion tracking. However, it overfits to motion clips of only a few seconds. GMT [5] constructs a general motion tracker with multiple careful designs in motion distribution sampling and network architecture. Although this method can track a considerable portion of data from LAFAN1 [16] and AMASS [17] datasets, it shows limited capability when dealing with highly dynamic and contact-rich motions. Moreover, GMT does not show adaptability to external disturbances, which limits its practicality in real-world scenarios.
blocks.zh: 最近，机器人学研究人员已开始探索在真实世界人形机器人硬件平台上复现人类动作 [1]–[6]，以相比纯强化学习控制器 [7]–[10] 实现更具表现力的动作行为。然而，与角色动画相比，由于跨具身差距、执行器限制以及仿真到现实迁移的挑战，人形机器人上的动作跟踪仍显著落后。HumanPlus [1] 与 OmniH2O [2] 主要关注准静态移动操作任务。ASAP [6] 实现了高动态动作跟踪，但它过拟合于仅数秒长度的动作片段。GMT [5] 通过在动作分布采样和网络架构方面的多项精心设计，构建了一个通用动作跟踪器。尽管该方法能够跟踪 LAFAN1 [16] 和 AMASS [17] 数据集中的相当一部分数据，但在处理高动态和富接触动作时表现出有限的能力。此外，GMT 并未展现出对外部扰动的适应性，这限制了其在真实世界场景中的实用性。

Any2Track demonstrates unprecedented levels of motion diversity, high dynamism, and contact complexity. It is worth noting that, although both Any2Track and GMT [5] use the combination of LAFAN1 [16] and AMASS [17] as the training dataset, GMT removed a significant portion of highly dynamic or contact-rich motions. Compared with existing works, Any2Track demonstrates unprecedented levels of motion diversity, high dynamism, and contact complexity within a unified tracking policy. More distinctively, our method endows the motion tracker with online dynamics adaptability to overcome the sim-to-real gap and various real-world disturbances, marking a significant step toward general real-world use.

blocks.en: B. Online Dynamics Adaptation for Legged Robots
blocks.zh: B. 足式机器人在线动力学自适应

blocks.en: A key challenge in constructing a fundamental humanoid motion tracker is to overcome the sim2real dynamics gap and various real-world disturbances for general practical use. Existing works [1], [3], [5] often rely on na¨ıve domain randomization in the hope that the policy can perform robustly under different environment dynamics. However, due to the unawareness of the environment dynamics, the policy cannot adaptively adjust its actions, causing it to behave conservatively when faced with large dynamic variance.
blocks.zh: 构建基础人形动作跟踪器的一个关键挑战，在于克服仿真到现实迁移（sim2real）的动力学差距以及各种真实世界扰动，以实现通用的实际应用。现有工作 [1], [3], [5] 通常依赖朴素的域随机化，寄希望于策略能在不同的环境动力学下鲁棒运行。然而，由于无法感知环境动力学，策略无法自适应地调整其动作，导致在面对较大的动力学变化时表现得较为保守。

blocks.en: To cope with more complex real-world environments for legged robots, existing works [9], [27], [28] utilize robotenvironment interaction history to adaptively estimate realworld dynamics and adjust robot behavior accordingly. Rapid Motor Adaptation (RMA) [28] learns to encode recent state histories into a latent representation of environment dynamics by distilling knowledge from a privileged teacher encoder. Li et al. [27] designs a dual-history architecture to overcome the sim2real dynamics gap with history information over varying horizons. DWL [9] utilizes a denoising world model to predict environment configuration and privileged robot states simultaneously from history information.
blocks.zh: 为了让足式机器人应对更复杂的真实世界环境，现有工作 [9], [27], [28] 利用机器人与环境的交互历史来在线自适应估计真实世界动力学，并据此调整机器人行为。Rapid Motor Adaptation (RMA) [28] 通过从特权教师编码器中蒸馏知识，学习将近期的状态历史编码为环境动力学的潜在表征。Li 等人 [27] 设计了一种双历史架构，利用不同时间跨度的历史信息来克服仿真到现实的动力学差距。DWL [9] 则利用去噪世界模型，从历史信息中同时预测环境配置与特权机器人状态。

blocks.en: Compared with existing works, we take a further step in online dynamics adaptation. To learn better dynamics representations from the history buffer, we introduce dynamics-aware world model prediction as a proxy task. The learned representations are more informative in dynamics. To decouple the acquisition of motion tracking capability and dynamics adaptability to reduce the difficulty of joint optimization, we introduce an adapter architecture and a finetuning stage on top of a base tracker to accommodate different environment dynamics.
blocks.zh: 与现有工作相比，我们在在线动力学自适应方面更进一步。为了从历史缓冲区中学习到更优的动力学表征，我们引入了动力学感知的世界模型预测作为代理任务，所学习到的表征蕴含更丰富的动力学信息。为了将动作跟踪能力的获取与动力学自适应能力进行解耦以降低联合优化的难度，我们在基础跟踪器之上引入了适配器架构以及微调阶段，以适应不同的环境动力学。

blocks.en: III. TRACK ANY MOTIONS UNDER ANY DISTURBANCE
blocks.zh: III. 在任意扰动下跟踪任意动作

blocks.en: We propose Any2Track in this work, a two-stage RL framework to build a foundational humanoid motion tracker. The design philosophy of Any2Track is to reformulate dynamics adaptability as an additional capability on top of basic action execution and decouple its learning process. Such a design can demonstrate exceptional robustness to environmental disturbances while preserving its motion expressiveness. Concretely, we first construct AnyTracker, a general motion tracker with a series of careful designs to alleviate the optimization difficulties brought by complex action spaces and track various motions, as shown in Section III-A. At this stage, AnyTracker is trained as a base policy without any dynamics randomization to avoid tracking performance degradation. We then propose AnyAdapter, a historyinformed adaptation module to overcome the sim2real dynamics gap and various real-world disturbances, as shown in Section III-B. At this stage, we introduce dynamics domain randomization and fine-tune the motion tracker for dynamics adaptability. The pipeline is shown in Figure 2. We use PPO [29] as our reinforcement learning framework and MuJoCo [30], [31] for simulation. We train our policy in parallel on 8 GPUs.
blocks.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了 Any2Track，这是一个用于构建基础人形动作跟踪器的两阶段强化学习框架。Any2Track 的设计理念是将动力学自适应能力重构为基础动作执行之上的附加能力，并将其学习过程解耦。这种设计能够在保持动作表现力的同时，展现出对环境扰动非凡的鲁棒性。具体而言，如第 III-A 节所示，我们首先构建了 AnyTracker，这是一个通过一系列精心设计来缓解复杂动作空间带来的优化难题并跟踪各类动作的通用动作跟踪器。在此阶段，AnyTracker 作为基础策略进行训练，不施加任何动力学随机化，以避免跟踪性能退化。随后，如第 III-B 节所示，我们提出了 AnyAdapter，这是一个基于历史信息的自适应模块，用于克服仿真到现实的动力学差距及各种真实世界扰动。在此阶段，我们引入动力学域随机化，并对动作跟踪器进行微调以获得动力学自适应能力。整体流程如图 2 所示。我们使用 PPO [29] 作为强化学习框架，并使用 MuJoCo [30], [31] 进行仿真。我们在 8 块 GPU 上并行训练我们的策略。

blocks.en: A. AnyTracker: Track Any Motions
blocks.zh: A. AnyTracker：跟踪任意动作

blocks.en: Our tracker can be seen as an RL policy π : G ˆ S ÞÑ A , which maps humanoid proprioception state and tracking goals to low-level robot actions. At each timestep t , the inputs of policy π consist of current state st and current tracking goals gt . st includes angular velocity, projected gravity, per-joint position, per-joint velocity, and last-frame action. gt depicts next-frame humanoid target motion, including target per-joint position, target per-joint velocity, and target rigid body information in the local frame. The policy π needs to output per-joint action at , which is further fed into a PD controller to compute actuator torques. The task goal of motion tracking is that at timestep t ` 1, the robot’s state st `1 should be as close as possible to the target motion depicted by gt while maintaining balance and safety. The reward terms we used are shown in Table II.

blocks.en: 1) Canonicalized Action Spaces
blocks.zh: 1) 规范化动作空间

blocks.en: The huge diversity of each joint’s action distribution makes it difficult for the policy to learn a general and high-quality control strategy. Thus, we propose to design a canonicalized motion tracking action space so that the policy only needs to predict a compact multi-joint action distribution.
blocks.zh: 每个关节动作分布的巨大差异，使得策略难以学到通用且高质量的控制策略。因此，我们提议设计一个规范化的动作跟踪动作空间，使策略只需预测紧凑的多关节动作分布。

blocks.en: 2) Motion Clustering and Specialist-to-Generalist
blocks.zh: 2) 动作聚类与专才到通才

blocks.en: Different categories of motions exhibit different motion patterns and action distributions, posing challenges for general motion tracker training. Therefore, we propose to cluster motions according to categories and train a specialist for each motion cluster. By doing so, each specialist only needs to handle a set of motions with similar action distributions, which greatly reduces the training difficulty and improves the final results. For LAFAN1 [16], as the motion categories are already provided, we train a specialist policy for each motion category. For AMASS [17], HumanML3D [32] provides motion categories labels (the “VERB” term in the annotation). AMASS contains a large number of motion categories, and thus training a specialist for each category would be inefficient. Therefore, we feed the motion category labels into CLIP [33] to compute text feature embeddings. Then we cluster motions based on these embeddings using the K-means [34] method. We split AMASS into 6 subsets and train corresponding specialists. At last, we adopt the specialist-to-generalist paradigm [8] and use DAgger [35] to distill all specialists into a generalist policy.
blocks.zh: 不同类别的动作表现出不同的运动模式和动作分布，这对通用动作跟踪器的训练提出了挑战。因此，我们提议按类别对动作进行聚类，并为每个动作聚类训练一个专才策略。如此一来，每个专才策略只需处理一组动作分布相似的动作，从而大幅降低了训练难度并提升了最终效果。对于 LAFAN1 [16]，由于其已经提供了动作类别，我们为每个动作类别训练一个专才策略。对于 AMASS [17]，HumanML3D [32] 提供了动作类别标签（标注中的“VERB”项）。AMASS 包含大量的动作类别，因此为每个类别都训练一个专才策略效率低下。为此，我们将动作类别标签输入 CLIP [33] 中以计算文本特征嵌入。随后，我们使用 K-means [34] 方法基于这些嵌入对动作进行聚类。我们将 AMASS 划分为 6 个子集并训练对应的专才策略。最后，我们采用专才到通才范式 [8]，并使用 DAgger [35] 将所有专才策略蒸馏为一个通才策略。

blocks.en: We argue that there are two key components for online dynamics adaptability: 1) a good dynamics encoder that estimates adequate environment dynamics features from robotenvironment interaction history buffer; 2) an effective training strategy that helps the control policy to properly leverage these dynamics features to adaptively adjust its behavior without sacrificing motion expressiveness. Thus, AnyAdapter utilizes dynamics-aware world model predication as a proxy task to extract dynamics features into neural embeddings from the history buffer, which can serve as an informative representation to tell different dynamics. To facilitate the motion tracker’s learning of dynamics adaptability, AnyAdapter refrains from coupling the basic motion-tracking capability with dynamics adaptability in a single network and instead introduces an additional adapter architecture.
blocks.zh: 我们认为，在线动力学自适应能力包含两个关键要素：1）一个优秀的动力学编码器，能从机器人与环境交互历史缓冲区中估计出充分的环境动力学特征；2）一种有效的训练策略，帮助控制策略合理利用这些动力学特征来自适应调整自身行为，且不牺牲动作表现力。因此，AnyAdapter 利用动力学感知世界模型预测作为代理任务，从历史缓冲区中提取动力学特征并转化为神经嵌入，这可作为区分不同动力学特性的信息丰富表征。为便于动作跟踪器学习动力学自适应能力，AnyAdapter 避免在单个网络中将基础动作跟踪能力与动力学自适应能力耦合在一起，而是引入了额外的适配器架构。

blocks.en: 2) Dynamics Adaptability Injection
blocks.zh: 2) 动力学自适应能力注入

blocks.en: Existing works [27], [28] often use a single network to handle both basic action execution and dynamics adaptability. Such coupling will increase the difficulty of network learning. When the dynamics vary excessively, basic action execution capability can be severely affected and tends to become over-conservative, which is highly detrimental to motion tracking tasks that demand expressiveness and anthropomorphic quality.
blocks.zh: 现有工作 [27], [28] 通常使用单一网络来同时处理基础动作执行与动力学自适应。这种耦合会增加网络学习的难度。当动力学变化过大时，基础动作执行能力可能会受到严重影响，并倾向于变得过于保守，这对于追求表现力和拟人质感的动作跟踪任务而言极为不利。

blocks.en: In this work, we reformulate dynamics adaptability as an additional capability on top of basic action execution. To avoid compromising the already acquired motion tracking capability. We freeze the network parameters of Any2Track and introduce an adapter [15] architecture for fine-tuning. The adapter ξ consists of M layers with zero-initialized weights ξ “ t ξ 1 , ..., ξM u, where M is the number of layers of AnyTracker network. At the beginning, the zero-initialized adapter does not affect the base tracker’s output. As finetuning progresses, the adapter injects dynamics adaptability into the base model through layer-wise feature fusion as shown in Figure 2. Such a training paradigm avoids degrading the already acquired motion tracking performance, ultimately yielding both rich motion expressiveness and strong dynamics adaptability.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中，我们将动力学自适应能力重新定义为基础动作执行之上的附加能力。为避免损害已获得的动作跟踪能力，我们冻结了 Any2Track 的网络参数，并引入适配器 [15] 架构进行微调。适配器 ξ 由 M 层带有零初始化权重的层组成，即 ξ “ t ξ 1 , ..., ξM u，其中 M 为 AnyTracker 网络的层数。在训练初始阶段，零初始化的适配器不会影响基础跟踪器的输出。随着微调的进行，如图 2 所示，适配器通过逐层特征融合将动力学自适应能力注入到基础模型中。这种训练范式避免了已获得的动作跟踪性能发生退化，最终同时实现了丰富的动作表现力与强大的动力学自适应能力。

blocks.en: In this section, we provide extensive experimental results in both the MuJoCo [30] simulator and the real-world deployment. We choose the 29-DoF Unitree G1 humanoid robot for all our experiments. Here, we aim at addressing the following three questions:
blocks.zh: 在本节中，我们提供了在 MuJoCo [30] 仿真器和真实世界部署中的大量实验结果。我们在所有实验中均选用 29 自由度（29-DoF）Unitree G1 人形机器人。在此，我们旨在回答以下三个问题：

blocks.en: - ‚ Q1 : Can AnyTracker improve the performance of general motion tracking compared to existing methods?
blocks.zh: - Q1：与现有方法相比，AnyTracker 能否提升通用动作跟踪的性能？

blocks.en: - ‚ Q2 : Can AnyAdapter outperform other baseline methods in online dynamics adaptation capability against disturbances from different sources?
blocks.zh: - Q2：面对来自不同来源的扰动，AnyAdapter 在在线动力学自适应能力上能否超越其他基线方法？

blocks.en: - ‚ Q3 : How does Any2Track perform in various real-world scenarios?
blocks.zh: - Q3：Any2Track 在各类真实世界场景中的表现如何？

blocks.en: A. Results of Tracking Any Motions
blocks.zh: A. 跟踪任意动作的实验结果

blocks.en: To address Q1 ( Can AnyTracker improve the performance of general motion tracking compared to existing methods? ), we compare AnyTracker with baseline methods and evaluate each of our major designs in this part.
blocks.zh: 为了回答 Q1（与现有方法相比，AnyTracker 能否提升通用动作跟踪的性能？），我们在本部分中将 AnyTracker 与基线方法进行对比，并对我们的各项核心设计进行评估。

blocks.en: - 1) Experiment Setting
blocks.zh: - 1) 实验设置

blocks.en: We use our curated motion datasets, as mentioned in Section III-A, to train all the methods in simulation. We evaluate on the AMASS test set and LAFAN1 following [5]. In this experiment, we do not introduce any dynamics variance, only compare the quality of motion tracking.
blocks.zh: 如第 III-A 节所述，我们使用精心整理的动作数据集在仿真中训练所有方法。我们遵循 [5] 在 AMASS 测试集和 LAFAN1 上进行评估。在本实验中，我们不引入任何动力学变化，仅对比动作跟踪的质量。

blocks.en: 2) Experiment Metrics
blocks.zh: 2) 实验指标

blocks.en: We use the following metrics:
blocks.zh: 我们使用以下指标：

blocks.en: - ‚ Success Rate (SR, %) records the percentage of successful tracking trials. For motion tracking of a certain trajectory, the tracking is defined as unsuccessful when the averaged joint position error or the root height error is greater than 0.2m.
blocks.zh: - 成功率（Success Rate, SR, %）记录跟踪成功的测试比例。对于某条轨迹的动作跟踪，当平均关节位置误差或根节点高度误差大于 0.2m 时，该次跟踪被定义为失败。

blocks.en: - ‚ Mean Per Joint Position Error (MPJPE, mm) is the average position error of all links.
blocks.zh: - 平均每关节位置误差（Mean Per Joint Position Error, MPJPE, mm）是所有连杆的平均位置误差。

blocks.en: - ‚ Mean Per Joint Velocity Error (MPJVE, mm/frame) is the average velocity error of all links.
blocks.zh: - 平均每关节速度误差（Mean Per Joint Velocity Error, MPJVE, mm/frame）是所有连杆的平均速度误差。

blocks.en: - 3) Baselines
blocks.zh: - 3) 基线方法

blocks.en: Since different methods utilize different simulators, motion datasets, and even different robots, directly comparing each method is unfair. Thus, we choose existing general motion trackers with open-source training code as our baseline methods and reproduce them in MuJoCo using our curated motion datasets. In this experiment, we re-implement OmniH2O and ExBody2.
blocks.zh: 由于不同方法采用不同的仿真器、动作数据集乃至不同的机器人，直接对各方法进行比较是不公平的。因此，我们选择开源了训练代码的现有通用动作跟踪器作为基线方法，并使用我们精心整理的动作数据集在 MuJoCo 中对它们进行复现。在本实验中，我们重新实现了 OmniH2O 和 ExBody2。

blocks.en: We also ablate our major designs in AnyTracker, including canonicalized action spaces ( Ours w/o CAS ) and specialistto-generalist distillation ( Ours w/o distillation ), to validate their effectiveness.
blocks.zh: 我们还对 AnyTracker 中的主要设计进行了消融实验，包括规范化动作空间（Ours w/o CAS）和专才到通才蒸馏（Ours w/o distillation），以验证它们的有效性。

blocks.en: - 4) Experiment Results
blocks.zh: - 4) 实验结果

blocks.en: The results are shown in Table IV. AnyTracker outperforms baseline methods in motion tracking quality because of a series of careful designs. The effectiveness of canonicalized action spaces and specialist-to-generalist distillation is also validated. These two designs help alleviate the optimization difficulty brought by complex action spaces and improve the final quantitative results.

blocks.en: B. Results of Adapting to Any Disturbances
blocks.zh: B. 适应任意扰动的实验结果

blocks.en: To address Q2 ( Can AnyAdapter outperform other baseline methods in online dynamics adaptation capability against disturbances from different sources? ), we compare AnyAdapter with baseline methods and evaluate each of our major designs in this part.
blocks.zh: 为回答 Q2（AnyAdapter 在应对不同来源的扰动时，其在线动力学自适应能力能否优于其他基线方法？），我们在本部分将 AnyAdapter 与基线方法进行对比，并评估我们的各项主要设计。

blocks.en: 1) Experiment Setting
blocks.zh: 1) 实验设置

blocks.en: In this experiment, we introduce dynamics variance in the training process of all methods. Training a general motion tracker across LAFAN1 and AMASS under environment disturbances is very challenging, and the specialist-to-generalist distillation process is quite cumbersome. Therefore, all experiments are conducted solely on the LAFAN1 dataset and remove the distillation process. We compare them in the following environments to evaluate their motion tracking quality under disturbances:
blocks.zh: 在该实验中，我们在所有方法的训练过程中均引入了动力学变化。在存在环境扰动的情况下跨 LAFAN1 和 AMASS 数据集训练通用动作跟踪器极具挑战性，且专家到通才的蒸馏过程十分繁琐。因此，所有实验均仅在 LAFAN1 数据集上进行，并去掉了蒸馏过程。我们在以下环境中对各方法进行对比，以评估它们在扰动下的动作跟踪质量：

blocks.en: - ‚ Terrains : We use Perlin noise [36] to generate smooth and natural terrains, where we evaluate the terrain adaptability of all methods.
blocks.zh: - 地形（Terrains）：我们使用 Perlin 噪声 [36] 生成平滑自然的地形，并在其上评估所有方法的地形适应能力。

blocks.en: - ‚ External Forces : We randomly apply a force of random magnitude and direction to the robot’s torso during motion tracking.
blocks.zh: - 外力（External Forces）：在动作跟踪过程中，我们随机对机器人的躯干施加大小和方向均随机的作用力。

blocks.en: - ‚ Physical Property Changes : We randomly change the torso mass, torso CoM position, and joint friction of the robot.
blocks.zh: - 物理属性变化（Physical Property Changes）：我们随机改变机器人的躯干质量、躯干质心（CoM）位置以及关节摩擦力。

blocks.en: Besides, we also compare them in an environment without any disturbances to evaluate their basic motion tracking capability.
blocks.zh: 此外，我们还在没有任何扰动的环境中对各方法进行了对比，以评估它们的基础动作跟踪能力。

blocks.en: - ‚ Vanilla PPO : We directly train the policy with the vanilla PPO algorithm as we described in AnyTracker, with dynamics variance introduced during training. The policy cannot observe the history or the disturbance.
blocks.zh: - 原生 PPO（Vanilla PPO）：我们直接采用在 AnyTracker 中描述的原生 PPO 算法训练策略，并在训练期间引入动力学变化。该策略无法观测历史信息或扰动。

blocks.en: - ‚ Dual History [27]: The policy can receive both longterm and short-term history as observations. The longterm history is encoded by a convolutional network and concatenated with the short-term history.

blocks.en: 4) Experiment Results
blocks.zh: 4) 实验结果

blocks.en: The results are exhibited in Table V. We observe that Any2Track surpasses all baseline methods under all disturbances. When there is no disturbance, our method achieves the highest success rate and lowest tracking error. When dynamic disturbances are introduced into the test environment, our method shows less performance drop on motion tracking compared with the baseline methods, which indicates our better adaptability. Notably, our method even outperforms the RMA (Stage 1), which takes privileged environment factors as input. This is mainly because Any2Track provides better dynamics features and an adaptable learning strategy.
blocks.zh: 结果如表 V 所示。我们观察到，Any2Track 在所有扰动条件下均超越了所有基线方法。在无扰动情况下，我们的方法取得了最高的成功率和最低的跟踪误差。当测试环境中引入动力学扰动时，与基线方法相比，我们的方法在动作跟踪上的性能下降更小，这表明我们具备更出色的自适应能力。值得注意的是，我们的方法甚至优于以特权环境因子作为输入的 RMA（阶段 1）。这主要是因为 Any2Track 提供了更优的动力学特征和自适应学习策略。

blocks.en: C. Real-World Evaluations
blocks.zh: C. 真实世界评估

blocks.en: To address Q3 ( How does Any2Track perform in various real-world scenarios? ), we deploy our policy on the real Unitree G1 robot and report the results in this part.
blocks.zh: 为回答 Q3（Any2Track 在各类真实世界场景中表现如何？），我们将策略部署在真实的 Unitree G1 机器人上，并在本部分汇报其实验结果。

blocks.zh: 1) 实验设置

blocks.en: We quantify the performance of Any2Track on real-world robots. As we show in Figure 4, we conduct real-world experiments under various disturbance conditions, including (a) complex terrain: we use wooden boards, cardboard, foam, and fabric as terrains; (b) external constraint: the robot’s back was connected to a hoist via a fixed-length rope as external

blocks.zh: 4) 实验结果

blocks.en: Table VI depicts the real-world deployment results. The performance of Any2Track beats PPO with domain randomization in all test environments. We found that the advantage of Any2Track increases as the environment disturbances are introduced.

blocks.en: V. CONCLUSIONS
blocks.zh: V. 结论

blocks.en: We propose Any2Track, a novel two-stage motion tracking framework for humanoid robots. Any2Track can track diverse, highly dynamic, and contact-rich motions under multiple real-world disturbances, including terrains, external forces, and physical property changes. Our work paves the way for a foundational humanoid motion tracker in openworld environments with general practical use. For future research, Any2Track can serve as a robust base motion tracking model for different downstream tasks, including wholebody tele-operation, humanoid skill learning, humanoid VLA model, and so on.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了 Any2Track，这是一种面向人形机器人的新型两阶段动作跟踪框架。Any2Track 能够在多种现实世界扰动（包括地形、外力和物理属性变化）下，跟踪多样、高动态且富接触的动作。我们的工作为开放世界环境中具有通用实用价值的人形机器人基础动作跟踪器铺平了道路。对于未来的研究，Any2Track 可作为鲁棒的基础动作跟踪模型，应用于各种下游任务，包括全身遥操作、人形机器人技能学习、人形机器人 VLA 模型等。
